why.bestCase: dpkg-l-full, span "            э" (12 spaces + a pool glyph), isolated p=2, occ=28
why.law: a repeated span in the frontier wire costs far LESS in situ than its isolated token count, because the spans a census finds are exactly the ones built from characters that already merge (space runs, glyph clusters). Proxy pricing overstates the gain by 2.2x on this rule and turns a +25 estimate into a -20 measurement.
why.consequence: this is the same dense-wire law that sank SYNTAXIS, measured at the level of a single rule. It explains MERISMOS universal refusal without appealing to its constants, and it closes the post-pass-dictionary class on the frontier wire by measurement rather than by argument.
